archive.title: Walter Johnson
archive.caption: Walter Perry Johnson, nicknamed "Barney" and "the Big Train", was an American professional baseball player and manager.

archive.title: 1924 World Series
archive.caption: The 1924 World Series was the championship series of the 1924 Major League Baseball season.

archive.title: Metropolitan Stadium
archive.caption: Metropolitan Stadium was an outdoor sports stadium in the north central United States, located in Bloomington, Minnesota, a suburb of Minneapolis.

archive.title: Hubert H. Humphrey Metrodome
archive.caption: The Hubert H. Humphrey Metrodome, commonly called the Metrodome, was a domed sports stadium in downtown Minneapolis, Minnesota.
